description: Memory-order mutants of the audio plan's SPSC rings. Killed only by a ThreadSanitizer build of gyo_audio_tests (configure with -fsanitize=thread) run with TSAN_OPTIONS=ignore_interceptors_accesses=0, which macOS needs to check the ring's memcpy writes; an ordinary build cannot see them. Run with tests/common/mutation/run_mutations.py --catalog this file --build-dir <the TSan build>. v8-arch-gyo2-sdl-a folded the two hand-written rings of Mixer.cpp into SpscRing.hpp: au-ctl-clip-handback-relaxed and au-ctl-clip-reclaim-relaxed retired (the same lines as au-sched-play-tail-relaxed and au-sched-render-tail-relaxed now, which cover both rings).

mutants.what: The producer reads head without acquire (v8-arch-gyo2-sdl-a: both rings share SpscRing, so this covers the returned ring too)
The producer publishes tail without release (v8-arch-gyo2-sdl-a: both rings share SpscRing, so this covers the returned ring too)
The audio thread reads tail without acquire (v8-arch-gyo2-sdl-a: both rings share SpscRing, so this covers the returned ring too)
The audio thread publishes head without release (v8-arch-gyo2-sdl-a: both rings share SpscRing, so this covers the returned ring too)
PlayheadOf reads a field only the audio thread writes (published), outside the board (Fable check, place 5)
